type: exploratory, post hoc (not part of the registered pilot analysis)
what: The pilot B estimate under M2R: M2 plus fixed effects for 40 km regions (EPSG:5070 cells, x // 40000 and y // 40000), computed with the confirmatory run_test.fit_twoway on the frozen pilot data, after the confirmatory plan v1.3 adopted M2R as its primary model (decision record p1c/history_v1.3_dev/DECISION_primary_model_M2R.md, written before this estimate was computed).
note: With 40 km regional fixed effects the pilot estimate is larger (0.079 against 0.063) and its statistic T = beta / max(SE) rises from 2.31 to 2.98. Its calibrated reading is in the confirmatory plan v1.3, section 1. The registered pilot decision is unchanged.
